Middle West Vino De Naranja Cask-Finished Whiskey is aged over five years. The first four years are in American white oak barrels. It is then harvested and enters a sun-soaked Vino De Naranja cask for another one to two years where it acquires soft notes of sweet orange peel. SPECIFICATIONS FORMAT 750 ml MINIMUM MATURATION TIME 5 years ABV 56% (112 proof) MASH BILL Dark Pumpernickel Rye Ohio Soft Red Winter Wheat Non-GMO, Open Pollinated Yellow Corn 2-row Barley CASK TYPES Toasted and Charred American White Oak
